currentDependencyStatus.meaning: Membership is exact ecosystem/name/version against current lockfiles, independent of historical evidence collection status. Historical entries and review findings remain preserved, but are not current dependency evidence or unresolved runtime items.

method: Exact npm archive integrity checked against package-lock; exact crates.io archive SHA256 checked against Cargo.lock. Repository files pinned by npm registry gitHead, archive .cargo_vcs_info.json, or official npm SLSA provenance with subject digest matched to the verified archive. Official attestation signatures/transparency proofs are retained but not independently cryptographically verified. No guessed SPDX templates; ancestor LICENSE copies identified explicitly. Nonstandard AUTHORS grants and explicitly source-linked official standard license supplements are manually identified by evidenceRole and manualEvidence. Source responses and linkage metadata retained; full archives hashed but not retained.
